title: Mark complete is in the row menu everywhere; it resets now, from a chosen date
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Find Mark complete in the row's three-dot menu on the asset tab, the worklist and a work order's maintenance card.
  2. On a work order card row whose lines were added, confirm it is the row's button instead.
  3. Read its (i).
  4. Open it and read the modal title and the line under it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Mark complete sits in the row's three-dot menu on the asset tab, the worklist and the work order's maintenance card; on a work-order row whose lines were added it is the row's button instead.
  • Its (i) reads: Resets this service now, from the date you choose. It won't wait for an invoice.
  • Every place opens the same modal, titled for the service (e.g. 'Mark PM-A complete') with one line beneath: 'PM-A resets now from the date below. It won't wait for an invoice'.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R1: “Mark complete sits in the row's three-dot menu on the asset tab, on the worklist and on the maintenance card of a work order. On a work order card row whose lines were added it is the row's button instead, per S16-R17. Its (i) reads: Resets this service now, from the date you choose. It won't wait for an invoice. Every place opens the same modal, titled for the service, for example Mark PM-A complete, with one line under the title: PM-A resets now from the date below. It won't wait for an invoice”
